manifesto_chapters.title: The Aurora Standard
manifesto_chapters.summary: Coastal conditions and typhoon climates demand higher engineering thresholds.
manifesto_chapters.content: We build electrical and security infrastructure specifically designed for the heat, humidity, and coastal weather of Aurora province and Central Luzon. No cheap consumer parts—only industrial-grade cabling, IP67 housings, and surge-protected breakers.

manifesto_chapters.title: Honest Startup Transparency
manifesto_chapters.summary: No fake badges, no overstated certifications. Real work with guaranteed service.
manifesto_chapters.content: We don't claim decades of fake enterprise history. We are a dedicated team of certified local technicians, electrical engineers, and smart system specialists committed to doing the job right the first time with prompt post-installation support.

manifesto_chapters.title: Unified Infrastructure
manifesto_chapters.summary: Power, Protection, and Intelligence working in total alignment.
manifesto_chapters.content: A smart home without clean power is fragile; a solar setup without load monitoring is inefficient. Cleverhouse unifies solar energy, heavy electrical wiring, automated gates, and smart home automation into one cohesive, effortless system.
